messages.subject: Ford Thailand | Manufacturing, electrification and government stakeholder leadership
messages.body:
Dear Ford Thailand Leadership Team,

Thailand's automotive manufacturing base is entering a period shaped by electrification, supply-chain competitiveness, industrial policy and sustainability. My background is built around managing exactly this type of institutional and operating complexity.

I serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My responsibilities include government and regulatory relations, ESG, corporate coordination, social performance and executive stakeholder strategy. I work across multiple public agencies and internal functions to protect operating continuity while advancing longer-term investment and sustainability priorities.

I bring practical transition experience through stakeholder and governance work around a major solar and battery-storage program, carbon-data readiness and complex environmental and regulatory interfaces. I also bring a record of coordinating official engagements, evidence requirements and executive follow-through in a remote industrial operation.

I would welcome consideration for Thailand or ASEAN leadership mandates across Government Relations, Corporate Affairs, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships or Country Strategy. I have attached a Ford Thailand-focused executive CV and would appreciate your forwarding it to the appropriate executive or talent leader.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
